title: Notif Notifs Events
description: Object representation for a single notification event

point.description: Target point or entity name associated with the notification

current.description: Current state value entered as a result of the transition

previous.description: Previous state value immediately prior to the transition

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the transition occurred

transition.description: Identifier classifying the transition type or trigger

alarm.description: Alarm-specific properties associated with this notification event
